screen.redstonenumbers.title: Redstone Numbers
screen.redstonenumbers.enabled.help: Display power levels on nearby redstone wire.
screen.redstonenumbers.range.help: 1–128 blocks. Default: 16. A smaller range reduces nearby wire scanning.
screen.redstonenumbers.limit.help: 1–65536 labels. Default: 1024. When the limit is reached, the nearest labels are shown. Lower limits help busy circuits stay responsive.
screen.redstonenumbers.scale.help: 0.25–4. Default: 1.0, matching the original number size.
screen.redstonenumbers.reset.help: Preview default settings. Choose Done to save them, or Cancel to restore your previous settings.
screen.redstonenumbers.preview: Changes preview immediately. Done saves; Cancel restores.
screen.redstonenumbers.save_error: Could not save settings. Your changes are still being previewed.
pack.redstonenumbers.clean_lines.title: Redstone Numbers: Clean Lines
pack.redstonenumbers.clean_lines.descrip: Optional clean-line redstone dust textures. No shaders.
